name: Harn Blackcairn
source_profile:
Harn Blackcairn (CN) is a former Blackforge foreman who became a fugitive after refusing to

surrender members of his workforce for illithid experimentation. Harn now organizes resistance
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 79 (source excerpt; may be partial)
